title: 手机凭啥知道你在摇它？
title_en: How Does Your Phone Know You Shook It?

segments.en: You just pick up your phone,
and it jumps into a shopping app.
The culprit:
shake-to-open ads.

segments.zh: 而且常常是你根本没想摇，
segments.en: And often you never meant to shake it.
It jumps anyway.
Now Apple steps in:

segments.zh: iOS 27.2测试版里，多了一个国行专属开关。
segments.en: a China-only switch in the iOS 27.2 beta.
Under Motion & Fitness,

segments.zh: 可以不让某个App读运动传感器。
segments.en: you can block an app from the motion sensors.
Today's brain-teaser:

segments.zh: 手机凭什么知道你在摇它？
segments.en: how does a phone know you shook it?

segments.zh: 答案藏在一个你天天都在用的物理定律里：
segments.en: The answer hides in a law of physics you use every day:
inertia.

segments.zh: 手机里藏着一杆比芝麻还小的弹簧秤，
segments.en: Inside hides a spring scale smaller than a sesame seed:
the accelerometer.
A tiny block of silicon

segments.zh: 挂在几根细细的硅弹簧上。
segments.en: hangs on thin silicon springs.
The phone jerks right;

segments.zh: 质量块因为惯性，往左一躲。
segments.en: inertia makes the block lag to the left.
Like when a bus pulls away
and you lean back.

segments.zh: 质量块旁边有一排梳子一样的电极，
segments.en: Comb-shaped electrodes sit beside it.
When it moves, the gaps change.
Gaps change, capacitance changes,

segments.zh: 芯片就算出：加速了多少。
segments.en: and the chip computes the acceleration.
No gears, no coils.

segments.zh: 全是在硅片上刻出来的。
segments.en: It's all carved into a silicon chip.
Twist one:

segments.zh: 你一动不动，它也有读数。
segments.en: even sitting still, it reads something.
9.8 meters per second squared:
that's Earth pulling on it.

segments.zh: 所以手机知道哪边是下，
segments.en: So the phone knows which way is down,

segments.zh: 你一横过来，屏幕就跟着转。
segments.en: and the screen turns when you do.
Your step counter uses it too:

segments.zh: 你每走一步，质量块就晃一下。
segments.en: every step jiggles the block.
But acceleration alone

segments.zh: 分不清你是在摇，还是在转。
segments.en: can't tell a shake from a turn.

segments.zh: 所以还有第二个小家伙：
segments.en: So there's a second little guy:
the gyroscope.

segments.zh: 里面的小质量块一直来回振动，
segments.en: Its tiny block vibrates back and forth nonstop.

segments.zh: 手机一转，它就被往旁边推一把。
segments.en: Turn the phone, and it gets pushed sideways.
That push is the Coriolis force.

segments.zh: 推得越狠，说明转得越快。
segments.en: The harder the push, the faster the turn.

segments.zh: 加速度计管往哪冲，陀螺仪管怎么转，
segments.en: The accelerometer feels pushes, the gyroscope feels turns.

segments.zh: 两个一起，手机就知道自己在干嘛。
segments.en: Together, the phone knows what it's doing.
So how hard counts as a shake?
A 2022 industry standard set numbers.

segments.zh: 加速度至少每秒平方15米，
segments.en: At least 15 meters per second squared,

segments.zh: 转过至少35度，或者摇满3秒。
segments.en: at least 35 degrees of turn, or 3 seconds of shaking.
15 is about one and a half g.
Normal handling shouldn't reach it.
As a rough estimate,

segments.zh: 差不多是使劲甩一下手腕。
segments.en: that's about a hard flick of the wrist.
Twist two:

segments.zh: 这只是团体标准，自愿执行，不强制。
segments.en: it's a voluntary standard. Nothing forces it.
In 2023, China's tech ministry called out

segments.zh: 有的摇一摇，灵敏得过头。
segments.en: shake prompts that were far too sensitive.
Set the bar too low, and a step

segments.zh: 坐车一晃，都可能被当成“摇”。
segments.en: or a bumpy ride might count as a shake.

segments.zh: 而且苹果的审核规则本来就不许
segments.en: And Apple's own rules already forbid

segments.zh: 拿陀螺仪这类硬件功能来变现。
segments.en: making money off hardware like the gyroscope.
So this switch

segments.zh: 等于拔掉了广告的“耳朵”。
segments.en: basically unplugs the ad's ears.
Twist three, the best one:

segments.zh: 这套传感器，正是机器人的平衡感。
segments.en: these sensors are a robot's sense of balance.

segments.zh: 人形机器人、无人机、平衡车，
segments.en: Humanoid robots, drones, self-balancing scooters

segments.zh: 都靠它知道自己歪没歪。
segments.en: all use them to know if they're tilting.
Hundreds to thousands of readings a second,
correcting every wobble.
Inside your phone

segments.zh: 住着一个机器人的小脑。
segments.en: lives a robot's sense of balance.
Without it, robots can't stand,
and drones can't fly steady.

segments.zh: 友情提示：这个开关还在测试版里，
segments.en: Friendly fine print: this switch is still in beta.

segments.zh: 叫什么、放哪儿，正式版都可能变。
segments.en: Its name and place may change.
Block an app,
and it may crash.
Android makers like Xiaomi, Huawei, vivo and OPPO

segments.zh: 早就有类似的权限开关。
segments.en: already have similar switches.
Your phone knows you shook it

segments.zh: 是因为里面有一杆会晃的小秤。
segments.en: because a tiny scale inside wobbled.
So next time an ad ambushes you,
don't blame your hand. Blame inertia.
